report.summary: tests/test_council_canary.py: Offline tests for the vendor canary covering truncation, anchoring, unavailable/wrong_answer distinction, budget/hung lanes, history round-trip, and dry-run.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_council_canary.py|Offline tests for the vendor canary with no network, no Ollama, no vendor CLI, no CLI entry point; tests truncation, anchoring, unavailable/wrong_answer distinction, budget, history, and dry-run.
